nodes.name: Send Teaser SMS
nodes.notes: locationId must be in the BODY (undocumented; GHL 422s COMMON_LOCATION_ID_UNDEFINED without it). Keep this expression trivial - the message is built in Build Recipient List because a nested {{ }} here breaks n8n's parser.

nodes.name: Fetch Pipelines
nodes.notes: locationId is required on the query string. Without it this 422s and the workflow concludes the Buyer Interest pipeline does not exist, so no opportunities are created and nothing says why.

nodes.name: Create Buyer Interest Opps
nodes.notes: 3 per 2s. At 5 per 1s a 166-buyer blast drew 46 rate-limit refusals from GHL - 'Try spacing your requests out' - and silently created 126 of 166 opportunities. This is the rate the SMS node survives at.

nodes.name: Anything to Write?
nodes.notes: Tests for a contactId being PRESENT, not for the absence of a _skip flag. _skip is undefined on a real row and n8n's boolean operator does not accept undefined, so the old condition sent every engagement write down the false branch - reported as success, wrote nothing.
